invariants.title: Intelligence stays with the App Agent
invariants.check: Reject package source or dependencies that call an LLM, instantiate an agent loop, or own conversation memory.

invariants.title: Web actions are declarative
invariants.check: Each route/action declares purpose, input schema, effects, authorization, risk, and a one-to-one capability id.

invariants.title: Generated output stays out of Git
invariants.check: Ignore <package>/web/ and generated seed databases; release CI builds them from a clean clone.

invariants.title: Product intent stays package-local
invariants.check: The workspace root carries tooling only; package outcomes live in <package>/roadmap.yaml.

invariants.title: Host capabilities are registry-governed
invariants.check: Never invent host.* ids in a generated package; request them through the platform registry.
